what: an exported archive now carries the chain head of the audit rows it contains, so a copy kept off-device can later prove the history was not rewritten

format.fields: auditHead (sha256 of the last audit row) and auditCount
format.export: filled from the live chain at export time; the app shows the first 16 hex characters after a successful export so the user can note it
format.import: the app recomputes the chain over the archive's own audit rows and rejects the file when it no longer matches the declared head

evidence.offline_check: recomputed chain over the 14 archived rows equals the declared head; changing one archived event no longer matches

limits: the head lives inside the archive, so an attacker who edits the rows can also edit the head; the protection comes from the user keeping the exported head separately
anchoring to a third party or a public log remains the only way to remove that trust assumption
verification: host suite OK (new archive audit test); RUN_SUITE 48 / TASK_CENTER 10 / RUN_DOCUMENTS 20 PASS
